evidence: monarch-wild-cinema score engine; laws inherited from the noir and stickman mixes where stated

policy.no_time_stretch: narration is never atempo'd; the picture is cut to the measured voice
policy.padding: no apad in this engine; the voice track is built by exact concatenation
policy.cues: one matched cue per transition kind, read from the same table the picture uses
policy.width: created at the SOURCE (independent detune + phase per channel), never by a bus widener

mix.duck_why: 18:1 produced 12 holes > 9 LU below the mean, one inside the CTA (stickman M21)
mix.alimiter_note: ~ -4 dBFS; AAC overshoots the PCM limiter by ~2.4 dB (noir 4.3)

measurement_scope: decode, time, level-check and per-band shares are measured. No independent human listening pass is claimed; any actual listening review must be recorded as performed.
